advisory_mitigation_options: Upgrade WordPress to 7.0.2, or 6.9.5 if staying on the 6.9 branch.
Install a plugin that blocks anonymous access to the REST API entirely.
Block /wp-json/batch/v1 AND ?rest_route=/batch/v1 at a WAF level (both URL forms must be covered).
